source_full_text: It was impossible to get rid of that it was as firmly fixed on her forehead as was the golden star on Lizina's. Their mother was furious. She first beat Lizina unmercifully with the broom, then she took her to the mouth of the well and lowered her into it, Leaving her at the bottom weeping and crying for help.
